Black & White series · BLW

Black & White

Released April 25, 2011 · 115 cards

Expanded

Black & White is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on April 25, 2011. Its main set has 114 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (115 in total). It includes 94 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 8 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Black & White. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (19), Masakazu Fukuda (18), Kouki Saitou (15), Kagemaru Himeno (13), Naoki Saito (6), Naoyo Kimura (5), Atsuko Nishida (4), match (4).
